title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**Location:** Delhi (On\-site, Full\-time)  
**Work Schedule:** 6 Days a Week (Sunday Fixed Off)  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 4 Years  
**Agency Experience:** Mandatory

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Senior Digital Marketing Manager** to lead and manage our digital marketing initiatives and performance marketing operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on expertise in **Google Ads and Meta Ads**, a deep understanding of performance marketing, and up\-to\-date knowledge of the latest advertising trends, platform policies, tracking technologies, and optimization strategies.

The candidate must have **prior experience working in a digital marketing/performance marketing agency**, along with proven experience in managing campaigns, budgets, clients/business objectives, and a team of digital marketers.

**Key ResponsibilitiesDigital Marketing \& Performance Marketing**

* Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across:
* Google Ads — Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, Shopping
* Meta Ads — Facebook \& Instagram
* Continuously optimize campaigns for **ROAS, ROI, CPL, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and overall business performance**.
* Conduct audience research, keyword research, competitor analysis, and creative performance analysis.
* Develop and test different campaign structures, audiences, creatives, ad copies, landing pages, and offers.
* Stay updated with the latest **Google Ads and Meta Ads trends, features, algorithms, policies, and best practices**.
* Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights and recommendations.

**Analytics, Tracking \& Reporting**

* Set up, monitor, and troubleshoot marketing tracking and analytics systems.
* Must have hands\-on knowledge of:
* **Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)**
* **Google Tag Manager (GTM)**
* **Microsoft Clarity**
* **Meta Pixel \& Conversions API**
* **Google Ads Conversion Tracking**
* UTM tracking and campaign attribution
* Basic event and conversion tracking
* Ability to understand user behavior through analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, conversion data, and performance reports.
* Identify tracking discrepancies and coordinate with technical teams to resolve tracking issues.
* Prepare regular performance reports with clear insights, learnings, and actionable recommendations.

**Website \& Basic Backend Knowledge**

The candidate must have a basic working understanding of website backends and should be comfortable making or coordinating basic marketing\-related changes.

**Must have familiarity with:**

* **WordPress** — Basic website/content management and marketing\-related updates
* **Shopify** — Basic store management, product/catalog updates, and marketing integrations
* Basic understanding of landing pages, forms, pixels, tracking codes, and conversion events
* Ability to coordinate with developers for technical implementations when required

**Team Management \& Leadership**

* Lead, manage, and mentor the digital marketing team.
* Assign tasks, monitor productivity, and ensure timely execution of campaigns.
* Train team members on performance marketing, analytics, tracking, and platform updates.
* Review campaign strategies and performance prepared by team members.
* Build a data\-driven and performance\-focused marketing culture.
* Take ownership of campaign performance and business outcomes.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with **design, content, video, sales, development, and other teams** to execute integrated marketing campaigns.
* Work closely with creative teams to develop high\-performing ad creatives, hooks, copies, and landing page concepts.
* Provide data\-driven creative feedback based on campaign performance.
* Ensure marketing activities are aligned with overall business and revenue goals.

**Budget \& Performance Management**

* Plan and manage digital advertising budgets effectively.
* Allocate budgets based on campaign performance and business priorities.
* Monitor ROI and ROAS while identifying opportunities for scaling.
* Ensure efficient utilization of marketing budgets without compromising campaign quality.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
* **Minimum 4 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience.**
* **Prior experience in a digital marketing/performance marketing agency is mandatory.**
* Proven experience managing and optimizing high\-budget Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of:
* Google Ads
* Meta Ads
* Google Analytics 4
* Google Tag Manager
* Microsoft Clarity
* Meta Business Suite
* Meta Pixel \& Conversions API
* Conversion tracking and attribution
* Basic working knowledge of **WordPress and Shopify** is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics including **ROAS, ROI, CPA, CPL, CTR, CPC, CPM, and conversion rate**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in team management, mentoring, and leadership.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams including creative, content, sales, and development.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven agency environment.
* Strong understanding of the latest digital advertising trends, platform updates, and policies.

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who can go beyond campaign execution and take **complete ownership of digital marketing performance**.

**The ideal candidate should be:**

* Data\-driven and analytical
* Strong in campaign strategy and execution
* Comfortable working with tracking and analytics
* Experienced in agency environments
* Capable of managing and mentoring a team
* Comfortable working with websites and basic backend systems
* Proactive in identifying problems and opportunities
* Updated with the latest advertising platforms, tools, and trends
* Focused on measurable business results

**Perks \& Benefits**

* Competitive salary package
* Opportunity to lead and grow a digital marketing team
* Exposure to multiple brands, industries, and performance marketing campaigns
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Fast\-paced and growth\-oriented work environment
* Opportunity to take ownership of large\-scale digital marketing initiatives
* Fixed Sunday Off

title: Video Editor
description:
**Job Description – Video Editor**

**Location: Kirti Nagar, New Delhi**

**Experience: 2–4 Years**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time**

**About TransCurators**

TransCurators is a leading content solutions company delivering high\-quality Content,

Editorial, Localization, Translation, Publishing, Digital Content, E\-learning, Creative

Services, and Video Production solutions to global enterprises, startups, and EdTech

organizations. We create engaging visual content for brands across corporate communication,

digital marketing, social media, learning solutions, and advertising.

As our creative services continue to grow, we are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented

Video Editor who can transform raw footage into compelling visual stories while

maintaining the highest standards of creativity, technical excellence, and brand consistency.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly creative, technically proficient, and execution\-focused Video

Editor to manage end\-to\-end post\-production for a wide variety of video projects.

The Video Editor will be responsible for assembling raw footage into polished, engaging, and visually compelling content by combining storytelling, editing techniques, sound design, motion graphics, colour grading, and visual effects. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of narrative flow, pacing, audience engagement, and platform\-specific content optimization.

This role requires close collaboration with Video Producers, Motion Graphic Designers, Creative Teams, Account Managers, and Clients to ensure every video meets creative expectations, business objectives, and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Video Editing \& Storytelling**

 Edit raw footage into compelling and engaging videos while maintaining the intended

narrative and creative vision.

 Understand project objectives, target audience, brand guidelines, and client

expectations before editing.

 Structure content to maximize viewer engagement and storytelling effectiveness.

 Create edits for:

o Corporate Films

o Brand Videos

o Social Media Content

o Advertisements

o Product Videos

o Explainer Videos

o Training \& E\-learning Videos

o Event Videos

o Interviews

o Testimonials

o Promotional Videos

o Podcasts \& Webinars

o Reels, Shorts \& YouTube Videos

o AI Videos

 Ensure logical sequencing and smooth transitions between scenes.

**2\. Post\-Production Management**

 Perform complete post\-production activities including:

o Rough Cut

o Fine Cut

o Final Cut

o Colour Correction

o Colour Grading

o Audio Cleanup

o Sound Mixing

o Background Music Integration

o Noise Reduction

o Subtitle Integration

o Captioning

o Video Compression

o Export Optimization

 Maintain organized project files and editing timelines.

**3\. Motion Graphics \& Visual Enhancements**

 Integrate motion graphics, lower thirds, transitions, typography, animations, and

visual effects.

 Add brand\-compliant graphics and animations.

 Create engaging intros, outros, title animations, and call\-to\-action sequences.

 Collaborate with Motion Graphic Designers for advanced animation requirements.

 Ensure visual consistency throughout the video.

**4\. Audio Editing \& Enhancement**

 Clean and enhance audio quality.

 Synchronize voiceovers with visuals.

 Balance dialogue, background music, and sound effects.

 Remove unwanted background noise.

 Ensure professional audio quality across all deliverables.

**5\. Colour Grading \& Visual Quality**

 Perform colour correction and cinematic colour grading.

 Match colour profiles across multiple camera sources.

 Ensure visual consistency across shots.

 Improve lighting and exposure where required.

 Deliver visually appealing content aligned with brand identity.

**6\. Collaboration \& Creative Execution**

 Work closely with:

o Video Producers

o Creative Team

o Motion Graphic Designers

o Account Managers

o Clients

o Production Team

 Understand creative briefs before beginning edits.

 Participate in creative discussions and brainstorming sessions.

 Incorporate client and internal feedback efficiently.

 Maintain effective communication throughout project execution.

**7\. Quality Assurance \& Final Delivery**

 Conduct detailed quality checks before final exports.

 Verify:

o Video Resolution

o Audio Levels

o Typography

o Graphics

o Branding

o Colour Accuracy

o Subtitle Accuracy

o Motion Graphics

o Export Settings

 Ensure error\-free final deliveries.

 Prepare multiple export versions for different platforms.

**8\. Asset \&; Project Management**

 Maintain proper folder structures and project organization.

 Archive completed projects systematically.

 Manage stock footage, music libraries, templates, fonts, and editing assets.

 Ensure proper version control throughout editing cycles.

 Maintain backup copies of all production files.

9\. Platform Optimization

 Edit videos according to platform\-specific best practices for:

o YouTube

o Instagram

o LinkedIn

o Facebook

o X (Twitter)

o TikTok

o Learning Management Systems (LMS)

o Corporate Portals

 Optimize aspect ratios, durations, subtitles, and formats for different platforms.

 Ensure videos are optimized for engagement and audience retention.

**10\. Process Improvement \& Innovation**

 Stay updated with latest editing trends, AI tools, and post\-production technologies.

 Recommend innovative editing techniques to improve content quality.

 Develop reusable editing templates and workflows.

 Build standardized editing practices to improve productivity.

 Continuously improve post\-production efficiency.

Cross\-Functional Coordination

Work closely with:

 Head of Operations

 Video Producer

 Account Management Team

 Project Managers

 Creative Designers

 Motion Graphic Designers

 Content Writers

 Production Crew

 Clients

 External Vendors

 Leadership Team

**Operational Authority**

 Ownership of assigned video editing projects from raw footage to final delivery.

 Authority to recommend creative improvements during post\-production.

 Responsibility for maintaining editing quality and technical excellence.

 Ownership of project timelines during post\-production.

 Authority to coordinate revisions with Video Producers and stakeholders.

 Responsibility for maintaining organized project files and archives.

 Escalate editing challenges, technical issues, and delivery risks to leadership.

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
**Designation**\- Brand Marketing Manager
  

  

**Experience** \- 5 Years
  

  

**Position Description** – Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it's equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.
  

In the capacity of a Brand Marketing Manager, you will ensure the efficient execution of business plans to meet future brand expectations and targets. You will also take part in the development of short\-term tactical Brand Management marketing plans. You will ensure brand integrity by guiding efforts across multiple channels and functions and support the development and execution of offline, digital, and paid social advertising programs for the business.
  

The role entails the management of media campaigns from the beginning to the end and is also responsible for the execution across all media channels inclusive of TV, Radio, Digital, Print, and Paid Social. The Brand Marketing Manager reports directly to the Director\- Womennovator.
  

  

**The Impact You'll Make in this Role** \-
  

  

**Strategy :** You will play part in the development of the brand marketing strategies in order to establish strategic direction and program positioning. In this capacity, the Brand Marketing Manager, you will develop marketing partnerships with media partners, and other external partners in an attempt to broaden the reach of the business’s brand messaging.
  

You will also play part in the development and execution of paid social programs on advertising platforms inclusive of Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, and Twitter etc. along with supporting the brand’s paid media programs. At this capacity, you will contribute to the development and execution of all online/offline events, promotions for the business/brand.
  

  

**Management:** You will play a managerial role in the production process for all offline marketing materials, for example, project timelines, and so forth. You will be tasked with the maintenance of the lower department’s operational production budget, ensuring that there is a continuous effective and economical allocation of resources. You will also supervises multiple external agencies in developing creative advertising, high\-impact promotions, and media planning,event sponsorship.
  

You will additionally manage media timelines and executes plans across all media channels, that is, TV, Social, Radio, and Print etc. you will effectively supervisethe junior marketing staff/team, managing workflow, providing direction, and overseeing constant skill development. You will strike a balance in ensuring all branding and key information strategies are in line with overall business strategy without compromising the brand’s integrity.
  

  

**Collaboration:** You will work closely with Director, in reviewing and approving all branded elements for advertising and launch materials inclusive of printed collateral, product packaging, online assets, launch toolkits, product logos, and videos etc..
  

In this collaboration, he/she also provides feedback and insight on the performance of program campaigns and relays them for further strategic development and solution formulation. You will serves as a collaborative partner and liaison between all internal product departments in ensuring integrated campaigns and cohesive strategies. Youwill also be tasked with collaborating with external partners in ensuring that all media plans are aligned with the business’s values and goals, are executed on\-time and on\-budget.
  

  

**Analytics:** You will also play an analytical role where you will conduct research and analyses, translating campaign performance into communication documents and reports, which are distributed to management and key stakeholders. Some of these documents are marketing briefs, competitive analyses, campaign recap decks, and so forth.
  

At this capacity, You will track spending on all media campaigns for the purpose of ensuring that brand marketing efforts always stay within the allocated budget. Here, you will actualize cost reports per project at the completion of each brand marketing campaign. You will prepare account management, expenditure, progress, and other related reports. Additionally, you will review targeted spends and make real\-time adjustments to optimize brand marketing campaign performance.
  

  

**Knowledge and Opportunity:** You will also conduct regular and consistent research and keep the business and the brand marketing department informed on best practices and the latest trends in brand marketing that ensure that the business does not lag behind of its competition and also in order to provide growth opportunity for the brand by capitalizing on the acquisition potential that alternative branding strategies/approaches may hold.
  

At this capacity, you will ensure that the product/service maintains a consistent tone that is relevant to the business’s brand and the audience, solidifying the brand identity by ensuring consistent, on\-time and accurate development, deliveryfor each brand marketing campaign.
  

  

**Other Duties:** You will also performs other tasks as designated by the Director.
  

  

**To set you up for success in this role from day one, Womennovator is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:**  

  

  

* MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing (Completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited university


* Five (5\) combined years’ experience in brand management or integrated marketing


* Three (3\) years people leadership experience


* Strong communications (written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal) skills, including tact, diplomacy, and ability to influence and navigate across a diverse and complex organization.


* Highly proficient in Ms Word, PowerPoint, and Ms Excel


  

**Age:** Preferably below 35 years as on the closing date for receipt of application

Job Description


SEO Manager\- B2B Industry  

  

We are looking for a results\-oriented SEO Manager with proven experience in the B2B space to lead our organic search strategy and execution. The ideal candidate understands the nuances of B2B buyer behavior and can drive targeted traffic, qualified leads, and long\-term brand authority through search engine optimization.  

  

As an SEO Manager, you will work closely with the content, product marketing, and web development teams to enhance our online visibility across all stages of the B2B funnel. This role requires a blend of technical SEO expertise, strategic thinking, and data\-driven decision\-making.  

  

Key Responsibilities:  

Design and execute SEO strategies tailored for B2B lead generation and enterprise buyer personas.  

  

Conduct technical SEO audits and optimize website performance, crawlability, indexing, and structured data.  

  

Perform in\-depth keyword research aligned with B2B intent and industry\-specific search behavior.  

  

Optimize on\-page elements (meta tags, headings, internal linking) and collaborate on off\-page SEO (backlinks, PR).  

  

Align SEO efforts with content strategy to drive mid\-funnel and bottom\-funnel organic traffic.  

  

Track and report SEO KPIs (rankings, CTR, organic traffic, conversions) using GA4, Search Console, and SEO tools.  

  

Monitor competitors, identify SEO gaps, and propose innovative optimization opportunities.  

  

Work cross\-functionally with content writers, developers, and marketing managers to implement SEO best practices.  

  

Ideal Candidate Profile:  

minimum 6 years of SEO experience with at least 2 years focused on B2B products or services.  

  

Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnels, long sales cycles, and decision\-maker targeting.  

  

Proficient in SEO tools: Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, GA4\.  

  

Familiar with technical concepts: site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, robots.txt, sitemap.xml.  

  

Strong communication and collaboration skills to influence across teams.
